applicability: Checking joint torque sign and analytic gravity compensation on an explicit scaffold
Providing a bounded predictor for later free-root load-bearing experiments
claim: In the exact certified L2.3 fixed-scaffold horizontal-link fixture, zero, 80 percent, 100 percent, and 120 percent of the analytic 4.9 newton-meter gravity compensation produce the certified negative, reduced-negative, zero, and positive initial accelerations and short-horizon responses.

evidence.certification_claim_boundary: This campaign can certify only the exact L2.0-L2.7 joint-actuator observations named by the source-pinned programs. Fixed scaffolds, free roots, actuator envelopes, hard-limit reactions, two-joint behavior, and anchor-observer failures retain their declared fixture scopes. It establishes no contact-bearing articulated limb, per-foot or per-contact load allocation, standing, bracing, fall arrest, getting up, gait, walking, accepted knowledge, or automatic creature guidance.

program.claim_scope: The fixed-scaffold horizontal link responds with the expected sign and magnitude at 0, 80, 100, and 120 percent analytic gravity compensation.

failure_boundaries: The frozen parent supplies an external scaffold reaction
A fixed-scaffold hold is not free-root support or an articulated load-bearing limb
No standing, bracing, recovery, gait, or walking is established
mechanism: Analytic gravity torque about the hinge is applied through the paired actuator path. Under-compensation leaves acceleration with gravity, exact compensation cancels it for the declared fixture, and over-compensation reverses the response.
scope: Only the exact 2 kg, 0.5 m single-link fixed-scaffold gravity-hold fixture, four compensation cells, short measurement horizon, and program claim scope certified by br4_20260723T090118Z_1760c2cf.
title: Single-link gravity compensation has the certified sign and short-horizon magnitude on a fixed scaffold
